zh.index.frontmatter.description: YaoXiang 编译器与标准库的全部诊断码索引
zh.index.intro: YaoXiang 的每个诊断都带一个稳定码号（如 `E1001`），便于检索、在 issue 中引用、以及在 CI 里按码过滤。诊断的用户可见文案（标题 / 模板 / 帮助）由 `locales/*.json` 提供，可用 `yx explain <码号>` 在终端查看。
zh.index.system.lead: 码号由前缀（族）与四位序号组成，族即编译器阶段：
zh.index.system.meaning.E3xxx: 代码生成错误（含 IR 层一致性检查）
zh.index.system.meaning.E4xxx: 泛型、特质与常量求值错误
zh.index.system.meaning.E6xxx: 运行时错误（VM 与 std 原生函数）
zh.index.system.meaning.E8xxx: 内部编译器错误（编译器自身的缺陷）
zh.index.system.meaning.W1xxx: 警告（码族属 W，默认发射级别 warn 不阻止编译；例外 `W1090` 发射级别为 error，会阻止编译）
zh.index.system.e3note: `E3xxx` 族此前未在任何文档中列出，现已并入本页；其码在 IR 生成期与入口点检查时产生。
zh.index.stats.registry: - `define_codes!` 注册表：**{count}** 项（{e} 个 `E` 码 + {w} 个 `W` 码）。

zh.index.stats.no_emit: - 其中 **{count}** 个注册码当前在非测试代码里没有发射点，标注为「暂未发射」——它们的码号仍然保留，但用户暂时无法触发。
zh.index.quick.e3note: `E3xxx` 族暂无独立分族页，全部码列在下方全量清单中。
zh.index.all.lead: 「模板」列取自 `locales/zh.json`，即诊断正文里替换参数后的形态；「发射点」指该码在非测试代码中的实际调用处数量。
zh.index.all.hdr.name: 中文名
zh.index.std.lead: 下列码**不在 `define_codes!` 注册表内**：它们由标准库原生函数在运行期经 `error_new("码号", …)` 构造，因此不出现在 `ErrorCodeDefinition::find()` 的查询结果里，但 `locales/*.json` 有对应文案，用户终端上仍可能看到。
zh.index.std.hdr.name: 中文名
zh.index.legend.span: - **span 豁免**：为 `true` 时该诊断允许没有源码位置（内部错误、运行期诊断等）。非豁免码在既无显式 `.at()` 又无 walk 上下文时会被拒绝（debug 构建 panic，release 落 `E8001`）。
zh.index.legend.no_emit: - **发射点 ⚠ 暂未发射**：该码在注册表中保留，但当前非测试代码里没有调用处，用户无法触发。码号不回收，避免旧产物里的诊断被复用成别的含义。
zh.index.legend.std: - **std 层运行时码**：见上一节，不参与注册表统计。

zh.warn.intro: 警告码以 `W` 开头，提示代码中可能存在的问题；默认发射级别为 warn，不会阻止编译。例外：`W1090` 的发射级别为 error（2026-10-13 用户裁决的同码升 E，见其条目说明），触发即计入 error_count 并改变退出码，会阻止编译。当前注册表共 **{count}** 个警告码，完整索引见[错误码首页](../error-code/index.md)。
zh.warn.vserror.warning: - **警告（`W` 前缀）**：提示潜在问题；默认发射级别为 warn，可选择修复。例外：`W1090` 发射级别为 error，触发即计入 error_count 并改变退出码，会阻止编译，必须修复（见其条目说明）。
zh.warn.deadcode: `W1001`–`W1005` 报的是**未使用的私有**（非 `pub`）函数 / 类型 / 变量 / 方法。`pub` 声明是对外接口，编译器无从得知外部是否有消费者，因此永不触发这些告警（#321 定案 B）。若看到「未使用」的告警，去掉对应的 `pub` 即可消除；反过来，需要被外部调用的声明请保留 `pub`。
zh.pkg.faq.a3: 这是预期行为（RFC-014a decision 1）。改用 `yx publish --github` 发布到 GitHub Release，或加 `--dry-run` 先做本地校验。

en.index.frontmatter.title: Error Codes
en.index.frontmatter.description: Index of every diagnostic code in the YaoXiang compiler and standard library
en.index.intro: Every YaoXiang diagnostic carries a stable code (such as `E1001`) for lookup, for citation in issues, and for filtering by code in CI. The user-visible wording of a diagnostic (title / template / help) comes from `locales/*.json`; `yx explain <code>` prints it in the terminal.
en.index.system.lead: A code consists of a prefix (the family) and a four-digit sequence; the family names the compiler phase.
en.index.system.meaning.E3xxx: Code generation errors (including IR consistency checks)
en.index.system.meaning.E4xxx: Generic, trait, and constant evaluation errors
en.index.system.meaning.E6xxx: Runtime errors (VM and std native functions)
en.index.system.meaning.E8xxx: Internal compiler errors (defects in the compiler itself)
en.index.system.meaning.W1xxx: Warnings (the W family emits at the `warn` level by default and does not block compilation; the exception is `W1090`, which emits at the `error` level and blocks compilation)
en.index.system.e3note: The `E3xxx` family was not listed in any documentation before; it is now part of this page. Its codes are produced during IR generation and entry-point checks.

en.index.stats.std: - std-layer runtime codes: **{count}** (not in the `define_codes!` registry; see the next section).
en.index.stats.no_emit: - **{count}** of the registered codes have no emission site in non-test code and are marked "Not yet emitted"; their code numbers are retained, but users cannot trigger them yet.
en.index.quick.e3note: The `E3xxx` family has no page of its own; all of its codes are listed in the full inventory below.
en.index.all.lead: The "Template" column comes from `locales/en.json` and shows the diagnostic body with its parameters substituted; "Emission sites" counts the call sites of the code in non-test code.
en.index.all.hdr.name: Name
en.index.std.lead: The codes below are **not in the `define_codes!` registry**: standard library native functions construct them at run time through `error_new("CODE", …)`, so they never appear in the result of `ErrorCodeDefinition::find()`. `locales/*.json` still carries wording for them, so users may still see them in the terminal.
en.index.std.hdr.name: Name
en.index.legend.span: - **span exempt**: when it is `true`, the diagnostic may carry no source location (internal errors, runtime diagnostics, and the like). A non-exempt code is rejected when it has neither an explicit `.at()` nor a walk context (panic in debug builds, `E8001` in release builds).
en.index.legend.no_emit: - **Emission site ⚠ Not yet emitted**: the code is retained in the registry, but non-test code never calls it, so users cannot trigger it. Code numbers are never recycled, so a diagnostic in an old artifact is never reused for a different meaning.
en.index.legend.std: - **std-layer runtime codes**: see the previous section; they are not counted in the registry statistics.

en.pkg.ProjectExists: The target directory already exists (`yx init` never overwrites it)
en.pkg.NotProject: The current directory is not a YaoXiang project: no `yaoxiang.toml` was found
en.pkg.DependencyNotFound: The dependency is not declared in `yaoxiang.toml`
en.pkg.DependencyAlreadyExists: The dependency is already declared in `yaoxiang.toml`
en.pkg.DependencyInstallFailed: One or more dependencies failed to install
en.pkg.InvalidManifest: `yaoxiang.toml` has an invalid format or incomplete content
en.pkg.Cache: Reading or writing the global package cache failed (RFC-014 Phase 3)
en.pkg.NotWorkspace: The current directory is not inside a workspace: no `yaoxiang.toml` contains a `[workspace]` section (RFC-014c)
en.pkg.MemberMissing: The manifest of a workspace member is missing (RFC-014c)
en.pkg.MemberInvalid: The manifest of a workspace member cannot be parsed or is invalid (RFC-014c)
en.pkg.NestedWorkspace: Nested workspaces are not supported: a member carries its own `[workspace]` section (RFC-014c)
en.pkg.PackageTooLarge: The source package exceeds the 20 MiB limit (RFC-014a)
en.pkg.ChecksumMismatch: The checksum does not match: the downloaded content differs from the lock file record (RFC-014a)
en.pkg.InvalidPackage: The package archive is invalid: it lacks a manifest, escapes its path, or holds an illegal entry type (RFC-014a)
en.pkg.Network: The network request failed (GitHub adapter, RFC-014a Phase 4)
en.pkg.RateLimited: The API rate limit was reached (RFC-014a decision 6)
en.pkg.RegistryDeferred: The official registry is not open yet: use `publish --github` or `--dry-run` instead (RFC-014a decision 1)
en.pkg.VersionAlreadyExists: The release of that version already exists (RFC-014a publish validation)
en.pkg.AuthFailed: Authentication failed: the credentials are missing, invalid, or rejected (RFC-014a)
en.pkg.PublishTarget: The publish target repository cannot be resolved
en.pkg.TestsFailed: The pre-publish tests did not pass (RFC-014a publish validation, step 3)
en.pkg.Io: The underlying I/O failed: disk space, permissions, a file held open, and the like
en.pkg.Toml: TOML serialization or deserialization failed (applies to lock files and manifests)

en.warn.intro: Warning codes start with `W` and report problems the code may contain; their default emission level is `warn`, which does not block compilation. The exception is `W1090`, whose emission level is `error` (a user ruling of 2026-10-13 upgraded the same code to `E`; see its entry): when it fires it counts toward error_count and changes the exit code, so it blocks compilation. The registry currently holds **{count}** warning codes; see the [error code index](../error-code/index.md) for the complete inventory.
en.warn.vserror.warning: - **Warnings (`W` prefix)**: report potential problems; their default emission level is `warn`, and fixing them is optional. The exception is `W1090`, whose emission level is `error`: when it fires it counts toward error_count and changes the exit code, so it blocks compilation and must be fixed (see its entry).
en.warn.deadcode: `W1001`–`W1005` report **unused private** (non-`pub`) functions, types, variables, and methods. A `pub` declaration is part of the public interface, and the compiler cannot know whether anything outside consumes it, so these warnings never fire for it (decision B of #321). When an "unused" warning appears, removing the corresponding `pub` removes the warning; conversely, keep `pub` on the declarations that other code must call.
en.pkg.faq.a3: This is the expected behaviour (decision 1 of RFC-014a). Publish to a GitHub release with `yx publish --github`, or add `--dry-run` to validate locally first.
